description: In any structure satisfying the input equations supported on finite \(S\), all pairs in the bounded closure have equal term values.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.closure_sound.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L))
  (E : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) (hE : E ⊆ S.product S) (M : Type w)
  [L.Structure M]
  (hM : ∀ p ∈ E, FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim p.1 = FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim p.2)
  (p : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L) :
  p ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.closure S E →
    FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim p.1 = FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim p.2
